text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Doesn't Maya look way more 
womanly now?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So yesterday, I thought, 'It's my day off, 
time to stay up late~♪' But then, 
Nature-chan told me—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Staying up late? If you wanna up your 
feminine charm, you'd better head to bed 
early, though!" ...That's what she told 
me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, my hair is glossy and I'm 
feeling fantastic☆ I'm gonna steal 
Trainer-chan's heart~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun seemed to have thoroughly 
rested both body and mind.
